items.title: CVE-2026-118527: exploited vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure
items.note: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

items.title: CVE-2026-111357: exploited vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure
items.note: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

items.title: CVE-2026-97229: exploited vulnerability in GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
items.note: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

items.title: CVE-2026-76418: exploited vulnerability in Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
items.note: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

items.title: CVE-2026-41709: exploited vulnerability in Broadcom VMware ESX
items.note: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

items.title: CVE-2026-46300: exploited vulnerability in Linux Kernel
items.note: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-48356: exploited vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.note: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

items.title: CVE-2026-111497: exploited vulnerability in Google Brotli
items.note: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

items.title: CVE-2026-109618: exploited vulnerability in PHP Group PHP
items.note: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-109619: exploited vulnerability in PHP Group PHP
items.note: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-114625: exploited vulnerability in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
items.note: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-110447: exploited vulnerability in Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server
items.note: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

items.title: CVE-2026-106931: exploited vulnerability in EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition
items.note: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-96656: exploited vulnerability in Plex Media Server
items.note: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

items.title: CVE-2026-96655: exploited vulnerability in Plex Media Server
items.note: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2006-4339: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in OpenSSL. When configured to use an RSA key with exponent 3, OpenSSL improperly removes PKCS-1 padding before generating a hash. This allows remote attackers to forge PKCS #1 v1.5 signatures. Consequently, OpenSSL may incorrectly verify X.509 and other certificates, leading to a bypass of trust and authentication mechanisms.

items.title: CVE-2023-0758: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A vulnerability was found in glorylion JFinalOA 1.0.2 and classified as critical. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file src/main/java/com/pointlion/mvc/common/model/SysOrg.java. The manipulation of the argument id leads to sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier VDB-220469 was assigned to this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2023-0745: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
The High Availability functionality of Yugabyte Anywhere can be abused to write arbitrary
files through the backup upload endpoint by using path traversal characters.



				


			


		


	
 This vulnerability is associated with program files PlatformReplicationManager.Java.

This issue affects YugabyteDB Anywhere: from 2.0.0.0 through 2.13.0.0

items.title: CVE-2023-1357: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in SourceCodester Simple Bakery Shop Management System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the component Admin Login. The manipulation of the argument username/password with the input admin' or 1=1 -- leads to sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-222860.

items.title: CVE-2023-25207: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: PrestaShop dpdfrance <6.1.3 is vulnerable to SQL Injection via dpdfrance/ajax.php.

items.title: CVE-2023-27407: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A vulnerability has been identified in SCALANCE LPE9403 (All versions < V2.1). The web based management of affected device does not properly validate user input, making it susceptible to command injection. This could allow an authenticated remote attacker to access the underlying operating system as the root user.

items.title: CVE-2023-29129: recently changed critical CVE

items.title: CVE-2023-29531: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
An attacker could have caused an out of bounds memory access using WebGL APIs, leading to memory corruption and a potentially exploitable crash.

*This bug only affects Firefox and Thunderbird for macOS. Other operating systems are unaffected.* This vulnerability affects Firefox < 112, Firefox ESR < 102.10, and Thunderbird < 102.10.

items.title: CVE-2023-34416: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Memory safety bugs present in Firefox 113, Firefox ESR 102.11, and Thunderbird 102.12. Some of these bugs showed evidence of memory corruption and we presume that with enough effort some of these could have been exploited to run arbitrary code. This vulnerability affects Firefox ESR < 102.12, Firefox < 114, and Thunderbird < 102.12.

items.title: CVE-2022-44276: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: In Responsive Filemanager < 9.12.0, an attacker can bypass upload restrictions resulting in RCE.

items.title: AfD
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In September 2026, the German political party Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) suffered a data breach which exposed 345k unique email addresses. The following month, hundreds of gigabytes of data containing hundreds of thousands of emails and attachments was published online, with searchable AI-generated summaries and downloadable original files.

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
